CR - Occasional survey of Cargo Ship Safety Radio
This is to report that the undersigned to this Society did, at the request of the Owner, attend on board the
subject vessel, whilst she was berthed at Kaohsiung on 25/09/2026 in order to verify the special conditions as
per the Dispensation Application DOC. NO. ES-2026-0626 which was granted by the Flag Administration on
21/09/2026 for the defective MF/HF equipment. For details, please see the report as follows:

1. All responsible crew members are made aware of this defective equipment through onboard training and the
training record was reviewed by undersigned surveyor satisfactorily.
2. The additional control measures to reduce risk as stated in Risk Assessment Report have been established
and be followed.
3. Both VHF radio communication systems have been confirmed to be fully operational and are to be
maintained available for radio communication and DSC calling.
4. The vessel’s INMARSAT-C, FBB and dual GX satellite communication systems are to be maintained fully
operational and available as alternative means for voice communication, distress/safety-related
communications, and e-mail transmission.
Upon the completion of above-mentioned examinations, it is recommended that the defective MF/HF
equipment be dealt with as soon as possible but not later than 14/12/2026.
